assertion.en: In 1934, Mohan Singh Oberoi mortgaged his wife's jewellery and put in all his savings to buy a small hotel.

reason.en: An entrepreneur takes risks by putting money and time into a business.

b.en: Both are true, and the Reason explains the Assertion: putting the jewellery and all his savings into the hotel was the risk an entrepreneur takes.

c.en: The Reason is true: taking risks with money and time is one of the tasks of an entrepreneur.

d.en: The Assertion is true: in 1934 Oberoi mortgaged his wife's jewellery and used all his savings to buy a small hotel.

explanation.en: Both are true, and the Reason explains the Assertion. Oberoi risked his savings and his wife's jewellery on one small hotel, which is the kind of risk an entrepreneur takes.

hints.en: Remember the five tasks of an entrepreneur. Which one did Oberoi carry out in 1934?
